text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but I should judge each position by its future prospects rather than treating it as a separate account or focusing on my purchase price.","The account value fell after I sold winners, a reminder that locking in gains does not prevent losses elsewhere or reliably improve overall returns.","With prices moving randomly and only a few trades so far, I should avoid inferring patterns from this short record and trade sparingly unless my reasons are sound."]}
